title: Architecture: modular monolith vs microservices, DDD lite

preview.what: Modular monolith vs microservices, DDD-lite boundaries.
preview.picture: One well-organised house with clear rooms vs a village of huts with roads between them.
preview.why: 'Would you split this into services?' — the right answer is usually no, with reasons.
preview.bn: গোছানো এক বাড়ি (modular monolith) বনাম রাস্তা দিয়ে জোড়া অনেক কুঁড়েঘর (microservices) — সাধারণত না-ই উত্তর।
